capabilities: Create and edit .rbase database files with typed columns
Switch between table, kanban, list, gallery, chart, stats, timeline, dashboard and matrix views
Compute formulas and rollups across relation columns
Sort, filter and group rows by any column
Import CSV files and export to CSV or JSON
extras: The store listing carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." The README states the runtime is fully offline with no HTTP requests or telemetry, audited against that policy, and points to a SKILL.md file-format reference for AI agents editing .rbase files directly. Beta versions are available via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Rowbase is an engineering fork of jysperm/obsidian-csv-database.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep structured, multi-view databases with formulas, relations and rollups inside plain, human-readable vault files.

relations.evidence: Rowbase is an engineering fork of jysperm/obsidian-csv-database.
Rowbase is an Obsidian plugin that brings Notion-style databases to your vault.

summary: Interactive database plugin that stores each database as a human-readable .rbase CSV file, with table, kanban, gallery, chart, timeline and other views.
